place.zh: 图书馆 · 古籍部 · 冬至夜
place.en: The library · the rare-books room · the winter solstice night

setup.zh: 加时赢了三分，没有一分是他的。冬至夜，他在古籍部的黑里静坐，数清了自己的心跳。
setup.en: They win overtime by three, none of it his. On the solstice night he sits in the dark of the rare-books room and counts his own heartbeat.

recap.en: Winter solstice night, sitting still. Heard it.

zh: 六十一；两指一搭：六十二。
en: Sixty-one; two fingers on the wrist: sixty-two.
"Winter solstice night, sitting still. Heard it."

story.zh:
加时五分钟，针推赢了三分，没有一分是他的。阿禾把他攥成一团的那只「0」号纸杯展平了，揣进口袋。马小宝坐在新地板上解鞋带，冲他笑：「没事。家里还有。」那只手在鞋带上绕了两回，没解开。

二十日，他翻那本抄本，批注断掉的那一页，页脚还有一行，比别处都淡：「冬至夜，静坐。不见。」

冬至是礼拜二。上午默写十二正经，他写出九条，一条把肺经画到了脚上，严老师批：「想象力好。」九月那笔，补测那天就免了账；中午他还是把十六块七排在阿禾面前，差一毛；她没提，在九月那行鸡蛋账末尾写了一个字：「清。」夜里古籍部修好的恒温机要人守，他说来给葛奶奶作伴。十点她去里屋，到门口回头：「看不见的东西，别使劲看。先听。」

他请下一部《奇经八脉考》，翻到一句：「内景隧道，惟反观者能照察之」。十一点半，他关了台灯。

黑得没有边。先听：恒温机，一起一伏；自己的喘，吸进去凉，吐出来暖；再往里，胸口一下很闷的「咚」，跳得很快。他长长吐了两口，那「咚」一下比一下松。不摸腕子，听一分钟：六十一；两指一搭：六十二。差一下。

他把老蔡枕头里捏的一根绒毛搁在上嘴唇上，吐得很慢，很细。它没动。

后来，闭着的眼前是一层极细的灰，灰里有一点亮，很小，偏上一点，不闪，不灭。他没去追，倒像在黑地里碰见了一个认得的人。

天快亮时，他在本子上写：「冬至夜，静坐。听见了。」葛奶奶送到门口：「前头那个，也是这样坐了一宿。他出来的时候，脸色没你好。」他还想问前头那个是谁，门已经合上了。外头天还没亮，台阶底下蹲着一团红黄的东西，脑门上一撮毛立着，把脑袋往他手心里一拱。
story.en:
Five minutes of overtime; Acupuncture and Tuina won by three, and not a single point was his. Ahe smoothed out the "0" cup he had crushed into a ball and tucked it in her pocket. Ma Xiaobao sat on the new floor untying his laces and grinned at him: "No problem. There's more at home." His hand went round the lace twice and didn't get it undone.

On the 20th, he leafed through the hand-copied book. On the page where the notes broke off, at the foot, there was one more line, fainter than all the rest: "Winter solstice night, sat in stillness. Did not see."

The winter solstice fell on a Tuesday. In the morning they had to write out the twelve regular meridians from memory; he got nine, and one of them ran the Lung meridian down to the foot. Teacher Yan wrote: "Good imagination." The September debt had been waived the day of the retest; at noon he laid out sixteen yuan seventy in front of Ahe all the same, ten fen short; she didn't mention it, and at the end of the line of egg accounts from September she wrote one word: "Settled." That night, the Rare Books Room's newly repaired climate-control unit needed someone to watch it, and he said he'd come keep Granny Ge company. At ten she went into the back room, and turned at the door: "Things you can't see — don't strain to look at them. Listen first."

He asked for a copy of the Study of the Eight Extraordinary Vessels and turned to a line: "The tunnels of the inner landscape can be illuminated only by one who looks inward." At eleven thirty, he switched off the desk lamp.

Darkness without edges. First, listen: the climate unit, rising and falling; his own breathing, cool going in, warm coming out; further in, a dull "thump" in his chest, beating fast. He let out two long breaths, and each thump came looser than the last. Without touching his wrist, he listened for a minute: sixty-one. Two fingers on the pulse: sixty-two. One beat off.

He set a wisp of down he'd pinched out of Old Cai's pillow on his upper lip and breathed out very slowly, very finely. It didn't stir.

Later, before his closed eyes, there was a layer of extremely fine grey, and in the grey a point of light, very small, a little above center, not flickering, not going out. He didn't chase it; it felt more like running into someone he knew in the dark.

Toward dawn, he wrote in the notebook: "Winter solstice night, sat in stillness. Heard." Granny Ge saw him to the door: "The one before you sat up all night like this too. When he came out, he didn't look as well as you." He wanted to ask who the one before was, but the door had already closed. Outside it wasn't light yet, and at the foot of the steps crouched a reddish-yellow bundle, a tuft of fur standing up on its forehead, which butted its head into his palm.

exits.means: the interlude ends and the story reads on
